title: SEMANTIC PROPERTIES OF COSINE BASED BIAS SCORES FOR WORD EMBEDDINGS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cosine-based bias scores (WEAT and Direct Bias) by measuring the geometric association between neutral target words (e.g., stereotypical job titles) and gender-defining attribute sets (e.g., 25 male/female word pairs like man/woman) in the embedding spaces of various pretrained language models.
